title: Goa Tropical Luxury Beach & Watersports Retreat
hotel_name: Sea Breeze Luxury Beach Resort & Spa
description: Indulge in 5 days of absolute tropical luxury in North and South Goa. Experience private beachfront access, luxury spa sessions, scuba diving at Grande Island, Mandovi river luxury sunset cruise, and authentic Goan seafood dining.
highlights: 5 Star Beachfront Resort Stay with Infinity Pool
Scuba Diving & Jet Skiing at Grande Island
Sunset Luxury Dinner Cruise on Mandovi River
Guided Old Goa Portuguese Churches & Spice Plantation Tour
Daily Chef Special Seafood & Continental Buffet Breakfast

included_services.transport: Private Chauffeur AC SUV Airport & Sightseeing Transfers
included_services.guide: Certified Local English Speaking Tour Manager
included_services.activities: Scuba Equipment, Jet Ski Pass, Cruise Entry Included

excluded_services: Flight or Train Tickets to Goa

itinerary.title: Goa Arrival & Beach Resort Welcome
itinerary.description: Private transfer from Dabolim / MOPA Airport to Sea Breeze Luxury Beach Resort. Welcome coconut drink, check-in to Sea View Suite. Evening leisure walk at Calangute Beach followed by candlelight dinner at resort.

itinerary.title: Grande Island Scuba Diving & Watersports
itinerary.description: Early morning boat transfer to Grande Island. Professional PADI scuba diving session with under-water video recording, snorkeling, banana ride, and jet skiing. Buffet lunch served on island boat.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage & Spice Plantation Experience
itinerary.description: Guided tour of Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral. Visit Sahakari Organic Spice Plantation with traditional Goan lunch served on banana leaves. Evening Mandovi river luxury sunset cruise with folk dance performance.

itinerary.title: South Goa Tranquility & Sunset at Palolem
itinerary.description: Drive to South Goa. Explore serene Palolem beach and Cabo de Rama Fort. Optional evening entry to Deltin Royale Luxury Casino.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at resort, leisure morning by infinity pool. Shopping at Panjim Market for Cashews and Feni. Private transfer to airport for departure flight.

cancellation_policy: Full refund 10 days prior to departure date. 50% refund 5 days prior. No refund within 48 hours of travel date.
travel_tips: Carry sunscreen SPF 50+, sunglasses, and light cotton clothes
Renting a 2-wheeler scooter requires valid original Driving License
Book water sports early in the morning to avoid long tourist queues

faqs.question: Is scuba diving safe for non-swimmers?
faqs.answer: Yes, certified PADI instructors provide 1-on-1 underwater guidance and safety gear for non-swimmers.

faqs.question: Are vegetarian and vegan meals available?
faqs.answer: Yes, all resort dinners and island lunches feature dedicated pure-veg and Jain food options.
